label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI, plus Uvation Pulse and Atlas CRM
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: Quiet since 1 Oct: no work was logged on 2 Oct and 3–4 Oct was the weekend. On 5 Oct the last GB300 attribute correction (PC-141) and image and attribute updates for three Dell AI servers (PC-142, PC-143, PC-145) were done, with one more in progress (PC-144). The catalogue re-check (PC-136), due 30 Sep, is still in progress. 8 open items are past due; 4 bugs are open, none rated.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Five new UAT bugs were raised on 5 Oct, two of them High (wrong CTA redirects on the Aerospace & Defence and Project Genesis pages, MR-1304 and MR-1307), taking open bugs to 15. The sitemap fix (MR-1199) and 29 Figma fixes have been Ready for Prod since 1 Oct and are not yet released; related products content on the AI Factory pages (MR-1265) is still blocked. 6 items are past due: MR-1168 and five June tasks in the 'In Prod1' status.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: On 2 Oct, 78 items that missed the 30 Sep sprint end were re-dated to 30 Oct, including the three S1 production bugs (wrong AI Factory prices and a Document API 502), which are still in To Do. Past due fell from 108 to 33, mostly items deployed to production but not closed, or in progress. 9 items closed, including two S2 notification and email failures (USP-4206, USP-4222). 47 bugs are open, 5 of them S1.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Nothing closed since 1 Oct. Marketplace sign-in for the AI chatbot (UC-225, due 15 Oct) and one of its subtasks started, along with two older Teams handoff items (UC-22, UC-43). The project has 180 open items, but 171 have not been touched in more than 30 days, so most of the 3 Sep agent backlog no longer appears in the 30-day figures here. Nothing is past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: No changes since 1 Oct. One item is done (PULSE-329). The other 328 (8 epics, 64 stories, 256 subtasks) are all held by Anshul Bhargava, 246 In Progress and 82 To Do, and none has a due date. Tempo shows 2.5 h in total, on 29 and 30 Sep.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: ATLAS-1 'R&D on CRM for MVP', held by Anshul Bhargava, is still in To Do with no due date. 5.5 h was logged on it on 5 Oct, bringing the total to 8.25 h since 28 Sep.
